# Scene gallery

All 137 scenes, grouped by category: 136 sub-projects, plus Hello, which lives in raylib-ios. Each name links to the
scene's own sub-project, where its page has the description and the source.
Build one to a phone with `bb <name>`, or all of them with `bb gallery`.

## Generative (9)

### [Spirograph](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/spirograph)

A hypotrochoid that draws itself, then resets. Build it with `bb spirograph`.

![Spirograph](../images/spirograph.gif)

### [Kaleidoscope](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/kaleidoscope)

A stroke mirrored with six-fold symmetry. Build it with `bb kaleidoscope`.

![Kaleidoscope](../images/kaleidoscope.gif)

### [Fireworks](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/fireworks)

Rockets and fading particle bursts. Build it with `bb fireworks`.

![Fireworks](../images/fireworks.gif)

### [Penrose](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/penrose-tiling)

A Penrose P3 tiling made by deflation. Build it with `bb penrose-tiling`.

![Penrose](../images/penrose.png)

### [Fourier Epicycles](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/fourier-epicycles)

Circles on circles that draw a square wave. Build it with `bb fourier-epicycles`.

### [Flow Field](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/flow-field)

![Lorenz](../images/lorenz.gif)

### [Life](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/game-of-life)

Conway's Game of Life, reseeded when it stalls. Build it with `bb game-of-life`.

### [Breakout](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/breakout)

Paddle, ball and bricks. Build it with `bb breakout`.

![Breakout](../images/breakout.png)

### [Snake](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/snake)

The classic snake, steered by swipes. Build it with `bb snake`.


### [2048](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/game-2048)

2048, played by swipe. Build it with `bb game-2048`.


### [Minesweeper](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/minesweeper)

Tap to reveal, long press to flag. Build it with `bb minesweeper`.


### [Pong](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/pong)

Pong against a CPU, paddle on a finger. Build it with `bb pong`.


### [Space Invaders](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/space-invaders)

Marching aliens and a one-finger ship. Build it with `bb space-invaders`.


### [Tetris](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/tetris)

The block-stacking puzzle by drag and tap. Build it with `bb tetris`.


### [Asteroids](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/asteroids)

The vector shooter on four buttons. Build it with `bb asteroids`.


### [Vampire Survivors](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/vampire-survivors)

Auto-fire survival with a thumb-stick. Build it with `bb vampire-survivors`.

![Vampire Survivors](../images/survivors.png)

### [Pac-Man](https://github.com/jlt-commons/raylib-ios-demo/tree/main/pacman)

Pac-Man, steered by swipes. Build it with `bb pacman`.

![Pac-Man](../images/pacman.png)
